## Checklist

- [ ] I inspected the final diff.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not contain unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] The Pull Request matches its linked Issue or qualifies as trivial,
      self-contained maintenance.
- [ ] Required architecture, API, dependency, security, or `unsafe` approval was
      obtained before implementation.
- [ ] Validation results are reported accurately.
- [ ] Tests were not weakened merely to make the change pass.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or contracts changed.
- [ ] No active vulnerability details, credentials, private information, or
      private AI links are included.
- [ ] Known limitations and unresolved risks are recorded.
